author: Dude Perfect
description:
You ask, we deliver....OVERTIME 50 IS HERE! Showcasing some new COOL (or not cool) items, breaking records, and a BRAND NEW SEGMENT! Also, an Overtime icon may be making his return...

#dudeperfect #overtime #overtime50

Huge shoutout to JLaser and his team for coming through and helping us out on Cool Not Cool, those builds were next level. If you want to check out more of his insane inventions, head over to his channel: https://www.youtube.com/@JLaservideo

Big thanks to the University of North Texas for hosting us, an awesome space and an even better crew. If you want to learn more about UNT, check them out here: https://www.unt.edu/

Shoutout to Dr. Song at Smile Lounge for hooking our interns up with some much-needed braces. If you want to see what they offer, visit: https://smileloungetx.com/

Appreciate the Bronzed Babes for pulling up and making sure our interns were… very noticeably tan. If you’re looking to get an awesome tan yourself, check them out: https://bronzedbabesoc.
title: OVERTIME 50 IS FINALLY HERE!!
